claims.quote: Rail passengers across Britain are a step closer to a railway run in their interests
claims.statement: Rail passengers across Britain are a step closer to a railway run in their interests.

claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new HQ will bring an estimated £151 million boost to the region's economy.

claims.quote: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to the city
claims.statement: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to Derby.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell headquarters is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: helping to cement the city’s role as Europe’s largest rail hub
claims.statement: Derby is Europe's largest rail hub.

claims.quote: supporting the government’s mission to drive growth in every postcode
claims.statement: The HQ supports the government's mission to drive growth in every postcode.

claims.quote: For too long, people have put up with a railway that often lets them down.
claims.statement: For too long, people have put up with a railway that often lets them down.

claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: Great British Railways' move to Derby will bring investment and good jobs for young people.

claims.quote: The biggest shake-up to our railways in a generation is underway.
claims.statement: The biggest shake-up to the railways in a generation is underway.

claims.quote: The modern fit-for-purpose headquarters in Derby will provide a focal point for GBR’s work, strengthening collaboration
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will provide a focal point for GBR's work and strengthen collaboration.

claims.quote: This foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the sector
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the rail sector.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The announcement is fantastic news for Derby.

claims.quote: Young people should have the chance to learn new skills and build a career in an industry with such deep roots here
claims.statement: Young people should have the chance to learn new skills and build a rail career in the East Midlands without having to move away.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 are scheduled to enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network

facts.quote: a fleet of new GBR trains set to be built in Britain
facts.statement: A fleet of new GBR trains is set to be built in Britain.
